Initial release date: September 13, 2016. Latest release: 10.3.3 (14G60) on July 19, 2017. Platforms: list of devices. Kernel type: Hybrid (XNU). License: Proprietary software with open-source components. Preceded by iOS 9. Succeeded by iOS 11. Official website: iOS 10 at the Wayback Machine (archived September 12, 2017). Support status: Third-party application support only.

We need to produce triplets with subject, relation, object, qualifiers, and types.

Define subject_type for iOS 10: "software". object_type accordingly.

Let's list each fact:

1. iOS 10 – developer – Apple Inc. (subject_type software, object_type organisation)
2. iOS 10 – source model – Closed with open-source components (object_type maybe "source model")
3. iOS 10 – initial release – September 13, 2016 (object_type date). Could be relation "initial release date". Use relation "initial release". object date.
4. iOS 10 – latest release – 10.3.3 (14G60) (object_type "software version") with qualifier point in time July 19, 2017. Also maybe include version number as object and date qualifier.
5. iOS 10 – platform – iPhone (object_type device). But there are many platforms; we can create separate triplets for each device. Could also group but spec says split coordination. So separate for each.
List devices: iPhone, iPhone 5, iPhone 5C, iPhone 5S, iPhone 6, iPhone 6 Plus, iPhone 6S, iPhone 6S Plus, iPhone SE, iPhone 7, iPhone 7 Plus, iPod Touch, iPod Touch (6th generation), iPad, iPad (4th generation), iPad Air, iPad Air 2, iPad (2017), iPad Mini 2, iPad Mini 3, iPad Mini 4, iPad Pro.

We need to decide object_type: "smartphone", "tablet", "device". Use generic "device".

6. iOS 10 – kernel type – Hybrid (XNU) (object_type "kernel type").
7. iOS 10 – license – Proprietary software with open-source components (object_type "license").
8. iOS 10 – preceded by – iOS 9 (object_type software).
9. iOS 10 – succeeded by – iOS 11 (object_type software).
10. iOS 10 – official website – iOS 10 at the Wayback Machine (object_type "website") with qualifier point in time September 12, 2017 (archived date). Could also include qualifier "archived" but we have point in time.
11. iOS 10 – support status – Third-party application support only (object_type "support status").

Also "default iOS 10 home screen on an iPhone 7" maybe not a fact but could be "default home screen" relation. Probably ignore.

Now need qualifiers list for each.

For latest release: object "10.3.3 (14G60)" with qualifier point in time "July 19, 2017". Also maybe "version number" but fine.

For official website: object "iOS 10 at the Wayback Machine" with qualifier point in time "September 12, 2017". Also maybe "archived" but not needed.

- device: "device".
